name: TRADElube
description: Integration platform + PIM that connects three ERP systems with Shopware, WooCommerce and Shopify and handles the whole product-data flow from backend to shop (founder-stated). Core niche: e-bike/bike retail (battery size, frame size, gearing etc.), expanding to electronics and tool retail. Solo founder Florian Feilmeier, Upper Austria, running it next to a 12-hour/week developer job; "in production since 2020" (homepage). Pricing: €79/mo (ERP → Shopware), €99/mo (WooCommerce), €149/mo (Shopify) (founder-stated). Built on .NET/Blazor + MariaDB Galera on Kubernetes (founder-stated).

mentions.evidence: €4,700 MRR from ~60 customers (founder-stated) No meaningful marketing in five years; first push is 20 handwritten letters/week to tool retailers (founder-stated) Note: not Stripe-verified.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one ERP popular with Polish SMB retailers (Subiekt GT / Comarch Optima / enova) and sell a traced, flat-price sync to WooCommerce/Shopify/Allegro. Ask the ERP resellers for referrals — they want their product to look better.

whyItPrints: Peak Conductor energy — glue between an old ERP and a web shop. Growth for five years came only from ERP vendors referring their own customers (no commission, no marketing). Support is 1–2 hours/week thanks to per-product end-to-end tracing (founder-stated).
